column1: # Content InDesign writes but its own schemas do not allow. idml-codegen adds
# each pattern to the content of the element definition, in every schema
# snapshot that defines the definition and every name the pattern refers to:
# into the interleave of child elements if the content has one, else after

column3: InDesign exports of DOMVersion 14.0 to 21.5 have <Endnote> in text, where the endnote reference is; the schemas allow it only in <Story>.
An InDesign export of DOMVersion 19.0 has a text field anchored in a table cell's text; the schemas allow only <FormField> there.
InDesign exports of DOMVersion 14.0 to 21.5 have the endnote's text in <EndnoteRange>: <Content>, <CharacterStyleRange>, <ParagraphStyleRange> and <HyperlinkTextSource>; the schemas allow no content.
